sn2.24:1.1: Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Ghaṭīkāro devaputto Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn2.24:2.1: Avihaṃ upapannāse vimuttā satta bhikkhavo || rāga-dosa-parikkhīṇā || tiṇṇā loke visattikan ti || ||
sn2.24:3.1: Ke ca te ataruṃ paṅkaṃ || maccudheyyaṃ suduttaraṃ || ke hitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ || dibbayogam upaccagunti || ||
sn2.24:4.1: Upako Phalagaṇḍo ca || Pukkusāti ca te tayo || Bhaddiyo Khaṇḍadeva ca || Bāhuraggi ca Piṅgiyo || te hitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ || dibbayogam upaccagun ti || ||
sn2.24:5.1: Kusalaṃ bhāsasi tesaṃ || Mārapāsappahāyinaṃ || kassa te dhammam aññāya || acchiduṃ bhava-bandhanan ti || ||
sn2.24:6.1: Na aññatra Bhagavatā || nāññatra tava sāsanā || yassa te dhammam aññāya acchiduṃ bhavabhandanaṃ || ||
sn2.24:7.1: yattha nāmaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca || asesam uparujjhati || taṃ te dhammam idha ñāya || acchiduṃ bhavabandhanan ti || ||
sn2.24:8.1: Gambhīraṃ bhāsasi vācaṃ || dubbijānaṃsudubbuddhaṃ || kassa tvaṃ dhammam aññāya || vācaṃ bhāsasi īdisanti || ||
sn2.24:9.1: Kumbhakāro pure āsiṃ || Vehaḷiṅge ghaṭīkaro || mātā-petti-bharo āsiṃ || Kassapassa upāsako || ||
sn2.24:10.1: virato methunā dhammā || brahmacārī nirāmiso || Ahuvā te sajāmeyyo || ahuvā te pure sakhā ||
sn2.24:11.1: so-ham ete pajānāmi || vimutte satta bhikkhavo || rāgadosaparikkhīṇe || tiṇṇe loke visattikan ti || ||
sn2.24:12.1: Evam etaṃ tadā āsi || yathā bhāsasi Bhagavā || kumbhakāro pure āsi || Vehaḷiṅge ghaṭikāro ||
sn2.24:13.1: mātāpetti-bharo āsi || Kassapassa upāsako || || virato methunā dhammā || brahmacārī nirāmiso || ahuvā me sagāmeyyo || ahuvā me pure sakhāti || ||
sn2.24:14.1: Evam evaṃ purāṇānaṃ || sahāyānaṃ ahu saṅgamo || ubhinnaṃ bhāvitattānaṃ || sarīrantimadhārinan ti || ||
